messages:
aashna: uploaded a compact mock: 'density ribbon' for rollout timeline in Figma -> https://figma.com/file/zzzz. ribbon shows percent density per version with subtle gradients, fits narrow view.
sam: looks cleaner on mobile. question: percent by default or raw req/s?
aashna: percent default, toggle to raw. hover shows exact numbers + cohort tag.
lin: pattern fills for canary/baseline/experiment would help colorblind users.
maria: +1. also need SR labels for each ribbon segment, don't rely on color alone.
aashna: plan: aria-live summary when focusing a segment: "11:15  v3.1: 18% traffic (mobile)  canary B". will add pattern overlays.
sam: rollback affordance in the mock is a small inline caret  worried about accidental clicks. propose explicit 'Rollback' action that opens a focused panel with a confirm flow.
lin: panel should preview affected variants, traffic shifts, and have a collapsible "Impact" section (latency/cost estimates). keyboard accessible and focus trapped.
maria: SR notes: announce a concise preview when panel opens, ensure aria-modal and focus trap. collapse impact by default.
deploy-bot: note: prod rollbacks require 2FA and admin role  include short copy under confirm button.
aashna: will update mock: ribbon + patterns, %/raw toggle, hover raw, aria-live summaries, rollback panel w/ collapsed impact, 2FA copy, explicit confirm copy. posting updated figma in ~90m.
sam: microcopy nit: change 'Confirm rollback' -> 'Confirm and rollback traffic' to be explicit.
lin: add transient undo banner after action: 'Rollback executed. Undo available for 5 minutes.' announce via aria-live.
maria: also please add an accessibility checklist in the file comments for handoff: keyboard nav, aria labels, contrast checks, pattern legend.
aashna: adding checklist and leaving thread open for any last nits.
thread_summary: Design review debating a 'density ribbon' rollout timeline: percent vs raw toggle, patterned fills for accessibility, aria-live cell summaries, and a safer rollback panel with collapsed impact, 2FA copy, explicit confirm wording, and undo banner.
